articles.headline: Week 10 NFL highlights: Best plays, moments, touchdowns, more
articles.description: Check here for all of Sunday's top moments, TDs and analysis from ESPN's NFL reporters.

articles.headline: Aaron Donald savors first sack in 1,050 days, but Rams' win 'felt even better'
articles.description: Aaron Donald recorded his first sack since New Year's Eve in 2023 and helped the Rams top the Cardinals for their fourth straight win.

articles.headline: Week 10 winners and losers: McCaffrey, Gibbs and Mahomes dominate on Sunday
articles.description: Christian McCafffrey, Jahmyr Gibbs and Patrick Mahomes put fantasy teams on their back in Week 10, while Jonathan Taylor and the Packers and Panthers' passing games had quiet days.

articles.headline: Ex-kicker Bill Gramatica sympathizes with Aidan Hutchinson, offers support
articles.description: Bill Gramatica said he'd be happy to reach out to Aidan Hutchinson to provide any advice for getting through a tough moment.

articles.headline: 49ers poke fun at Cowboys multiple times to headline NFL Week 10 trolls
articles.description: NFL teams kept it petty in Week 10, led by the San Francisco 49ers poking fun at the Dallas Cowboys.

articles.headline: Panthers 'talking about' penalties after nearly squandering win vs. Saints
articles.description: Breaking records for penalties isn't the usual path to victory, and coach Dave Canales says the issues will be addressed.

articles.headline: Fantasy buzz: Week 10's leading scorers through Sunday's 4 p.m. ET games
articles.description: Kansas City rookie Emmett Johnson stepped in for Kenneth Walker III and was one of the top fantasy scorers of Week 10.

articles.description: 49ers outlast Cowboys in back-and-forth thriller

articles.headline: McCaffrey's TDs of 74 and 66 yards and Samuel's 70-yard score help 49ers beat Cowboys 46-40
articles.description: — Brock Purdy threw touchdown passes of 74 and 66 yards to Christian McCaffrey, Deebo Samuel ran 70 yards for a score on a reverse and the San Francisco 49ers beat the Dallas Cowboys 46-40 on Sunday.

articles.headline: NFL Week 10: Big takeaways, questions and fantasy spin from Sunday's games
articles.description: Our NFL Nation reporters react to all the action, answering the biggest questions coming out of each Sunday game. Here's what we learned from Week 10.

articles.headline: Patrick Mahomes stars for Chiefs, strikes early connection with Josh Downs
articles.description: Even with an elbow injury, Patrick Mahomes was able to have his best performance of the year to lead the Chiefs to a dominant 35-13 win over the Falcons.

articles.headline: Seahawks beat Raiders 21-13 as Drew Lock throws for 2 TDs and Seattle sacks Fernando Mendoza 6 times
articles.description: — The lead-up to Sunday's Seattle-Las Vegas matchup was almost all about Fernando Mendoza, at last receiving his first start as the Raiders' quarterback.

articles.headline: Rams win their 4th straight game, overcoming a slow start to crush the Cardinals 34-6
articles.description: — Beaux Limmer was snapping the ball, Xavier Smith and Davis Allen were catching it and Kamren Kinchens came up with a key interception.

articles.headline: Citing short week, Colts sticking with Daniel Jones at QB despite dreadful start
articles.description: Colts coach Shane Steichen said the team will stick with Daniel Jones as starter despite a two-interception start that earned him a 2026-worst 1.7 QBR.

articles.headline: Kirk Cousins emotional after win in Vikings return, reflects on 'tough 3 years'
articles.description: Kirk Cousins was emotional discussing his return to the Vikings after their victory over the Packers.

articles.headline: Browns' Deshaun Watson relishes 'special' win vs. Texans after engineering rally
articles.description: Deshaun Watson, who delivered his sixth game-winning drive of the season, called the 27-24 victory over the Texans, his former team, "definitely special."

articles.headline: QB Jordan Love, Packers frustrated after blowout loss at home to Vikings
articles.description: Jordan Love and the Packers expressed their frustration after a 30-10 loss to the Vikings.
